notes: The readable reconstruction emits the complete 460-byte owner extent with identical calls, branches, registers, memory operations, constants, literal words, and control flow outside four localized instruction-ordering hunks.
The classic exact-only winner reduces the raw residual to nine halfwords without changing semantics, but the readable 11-halfword source is retained as the evidence artifact.
Relocation-aware comparison of the independently assembled retained owner proves all 284 unmasked core bytes identical across the six GS1 editions.

The exact caller at 0x080955b0 selects this runner for page two, and this owner installs the locally named callback at 0x08095c08 on each of 24 slots before later advancing those slots to states two and five.
Recovered only from retained owner assembly, approved local GS1 ROMs, local callers and exact battle-effect sources, and the approved compiler. No GS2 evidence or external game source was used.
